components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

A witch-type performer brings the one skill the one on the circle has chosen to mastery, on a full-moon night. This one masters Common skills.
A resistance, an intrinsic or a common skill. Choose the skill on the Skills page of the hub. A resistance has its learning finished: it has no mastery.
By default costs 100,000 base Max EP, spent once it is mastered, and 5 diamond blocks and 5 echo shards. One rite per player every 7 days.
